prisoner.name: Martina Linnehan
prisoner.description: Martina Linnehan was one of the GE Three anti-nuclear protesters prosecuted following an October 1982 action at General Electric in Largo, Florida. Convicted with John Linnehan on May 18, 1983, the three returned to jail after sentencing on May 26. A later contemporary report confirms that all three were released in 1983; their exact release dates remain unverified.
prisoner.body: Contemporary sources: Nuclear Resister 17, page 4; Nuclear Resister 21, page 3, recently released listing.

case.charges: Criminal mischief, culpable negligence, trespass, resisting arrest without violence, and unlawful assembly: GE Three anti-nuclear protest, Largo, Florida.
case.convicted: Convicted May 18, 1983 following a three-day jury trial on eighteen misdemeanor counts.
case.sentence: Concurrent six-month and one-year sentences reported at May 26, 1983 sentencing. Released on bond between conviction and sentencing; returned to jail after sentencing without posting appeal bond. Actual release confirmed in 1983, exact day and month unresolved. January 1 is a year-only storage placeholder. Arrest month October 1982: contemporary report gives October 27 while the University of Florida archival account quotes October 14; neither day is asserted. Nominal sentence is not actual time served. Sources: https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR017_19830606small.pdf#page=4 ; https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR021_19831115small.pdf#page=3 ; https://pkyonge.uflib.ufl.edu/2022/07/20/the-florida-peace-movement-collection/
